title: Judge a held user host lock from one opened file
summary: When `ia host claude --user` finds its lock, `<IA home>/claude/.lock`, held by another run, @inventarch/distribution now judges whether that lock is stale from one opened file: its type, age and pid all come from a single descriptor, and a stale lock is removed only after its name is found, while that descriptor is open, to still name the judged file (CodeQL js/file-system-race). A lock that replaced the judged file before that check is therefore no longer removed; a brief window between the check and the removal remains, as Node has no unlink-if-same. A symbolic link or other non-regular file at the lock path now counts as busy and is not taken over, and a FIFO at the lock path no longer hangs the takeover; each refuses IA-DIST-INSTALL-BUSY, as does a lock file the run cannot open. Locks the CLI writes are judged as before: taken over once their pid has died, after 10 minutes, or after 10 seconds when their pid is empty or unparseable. The IA-DIST-INSTALL-BUSY message is unchanged.
